days.title: Arrival on the Huangpu
days.notes: Fly into PVG. Light walking day. Reach the Bund after dark if the flight allows.

attractions.name: The Bund
attractions.description: Waterfront of colonial banks facing the Pudong skyline.

days.title: Pudong and the Bund
days.notes: Skyline from Lujiazui by day, then walk the Bund in better light.

attractions.name: Lujiazui
attractions.description: Pudong financial district and river viewpoint.

attractions.name: The Bund
attractions.description: Daylight walk of the same waterfront, looking back at Pudong.

days.title: Concession streets and museum
days.notes: Slow streets in the former French Concession, then Shanghai Museum East.

attractions.name: French Concession
attractions.description: Plane-tree streets, lane houses, and cafes south of Huaihai Road.

attractions.name: Shanghai Museum East
attractions.description: The city's main collection of bronze, painting, and ceramics in Pudong.

days.title: Old city and West Bund
days.notes: Yu Garden in the morning. West Bund river walk if energy remains. Last night in Shanghai.

attractions.name: Yu Garden
attractions.description: Ming garden and old-city streets beside the City God Temple.

attractions.name: West Bund
attractions.description: Huangpu industrial waterfront reused for galleries and walking.

days.title: Shanghai to Nantong
days.notes: Hongqiao to Nantong West, then the Haohe moat. Reconfirm the train on 12306.

attractions.name: Haohe
attractions.description: City moat loop with gardens, museums, and walking paths.

days.title: Langshan and Tangzha
days.notes: Wolf Hill in the morning. Tangzha industrial town in the afternoon.

attractions.name: Langshan
attractions.description: Temple hill at a bend of the Yangtze, south of the old city.

attractions.name: Nantong Museum
attractions.description: Zhang Jian's museum garden on the Haohe, among the earliest in China.

attractions.name: Tangzha
attractions.description: Early mill town and industrial streets northwest of the center.

days.title: Nantong to Nanjing
days.notes: Morning C-train into Nanjing. Presidential Palace and a first walk of the wall if time.

attractions.name: Presidential Palace
attractions.description: Late-Qing and Republican compound in the city center.

days.title: Purple Mountain
days.notes: Ming Xiaoling and Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum. Xuanwu Lake on the way back into the city.

attractions.name: Ming Xiaoling
attractions.description: Tomb of the Hongwu emperor on the south slope of Purple Mountain.

attractions.name: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum
attractions.description: Memorial stairs and hall above the pine forest.

attractions.name: Xuanwu Lake
attractions.description: City lake under the wall, between Purple Mountain and Xinjiekou.

days.title: Wall, museum, Fuzimiao
days.notes: City wall in daylight. Nanjing Museum before it closes. Confucius Temple after dark.

attractions.name: Nanjing City Wall
attractions.description: Ming brick wall; Zhonghua Gate or Taicheng are the usual walks.

attractions.name: Nanjing Museum
attractions.description: Provincial museum east of the wall. Book a free timed ticket.

attractions.name: Fuzimiao
attractions.description: Confucius Temple and Qinhuai River lantern streets.

days.title: Nanjing to Suzhou
days.notes: Afternoon G-train. Humble Administrator's Garden if you arrive with daylight, otherwise Pingjiang Road after dark.

attractions.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
attractions.description: Largest of the classical gardens, just north of the old city.

attractions.name: Pingjiang Road
attractions.description: Canal street of white walls and stone bridges.

days.title: Gardens and Suzhou Museum
days.notes: Lingering Garden in the morning. I.M. Pei's Suzhou Museum next door to the Humble Administrator's Garden. Master of the Nets at dusk if the night opening is running.

attractions.name: Lingering Garden
attractions.description: West-side garden known for borrowed views and scholar's rocks.

attractions.name: Suzhou Museum
attractions.description: I.M. Pei museum of jade, painting, and local craft beside the garden.

attractions.name: Master of the Nets Garden
attractions.description: Smallest of the great gardens; compact courtyards off Shiquan Street.

days.title: Tiger Hill and Shantang
days.notes: Tiger Hill in the morning. Shantang Street back toward the center. Last night in Suzhou.

attractions.name: Tiger Hill
attractions.description: Leaning Yunyan Pagoda and quarry park northwest of the old city.

attractions.name: Shantang Street
attractions.description: Canal street from Changmen out toward Tiger Hill.

days.title: Suzhou to Hangzhou
days.notes: Afternoon train to Hangzhou East. West Lake for sunset if the light is clean.

attractions.name: West Lake
attractions.description: The lake that organizes the whole city. Walk, do not rush the circuit.

attractions.name: Broken Bridge
attractions.description: Bai Causeway entrance to the lake, looking toward the hills.

days.title: West Lake circuit
days.notes: Su Causeway on foot or by bike. Leifeng Pagoda on the south shore.

attractions.name: Su Causeway
attractions.description: Six-bridge causeway across the lake, best in low autumn light.

attractions.name: Leifeng Pagoda
attractions.description: Rebuilt pagoda on the south shore with a view back over the lake.

days.title: Lingyin and Longjing
days.notes: Lingyin Temple and Feilai Peak in the morning. Tea hills at Longjing in the afternoon. Pack for two nights on Huangshan.

attractions.name: Lingyin Temple
attractions.description: Large Chan temple in the hills west of the lake.

attractions.name: Feilai Peak
attractions.description: Cliff sculptures on the walk into Lingyin.

attractions.name: Longjing Village
attractions.description: Tea terraces above the lake. Walk, taste, do not buy a crate.

days.title: Hangzhou to Huangshan
days.notes: Early train to Huangshan North, taxi to Tangkou, Yungu cable car up. Sunset from Refreshing Terrace or Beihai. First night on the mountain. Book park tickets, cable car, and a Beihai or Xihai bed before you go; November weather can close the upper trails.

attractions.name: Yungu Cableway
attractions.description: East-side cable car onto the mountain, the usual ascent with luggage.

attractions.name: Beihai
attractions.description: North summit plateau and the usual first-night base.

attractions.name: Refreshing Terrace
attractions.description: Classic sunrise and sea-of-clouds terrace above Beihai.

days.title: Summit day
days.notes: Sunrise, then West Sea Grand Canyon, Flying Rock, and Bright Summit. Second night on the mountain. Keep the descent for tomorrow so you are not hiking down in the dark.

attractions.name: West Sea Grand Canyon
attractions.description: Stepped trail into the western cliffs. Allow half a day.

attractions.name: Flying Rock
attractions.description: Balanced boulder on the ridge toward Bright Summit.

attractions.name: Bright Summit
attractions.description: Open summit and a wide view in every direction.

days.title: Descend to Hongcun
days.notes: Sunrise if the sky is clear, then down by Yungu or past Guest-Greeting Pine and Yuping. Taxi to Hongcun for the afternoon. Book the village ticket on the Yi County mini program.

attractions.name: Guest-Greeting Pine
attractions.description: The pine at Yuping, on the western descent if you take that trail.

attractions.name: Hongcun
attractions.description: Ming–Qing village laid out as a water ox, south of the mountain.

days.title: Xidi and Tunxi
days.notes: Xidi in the morning. Tunxi Old Street in the afternoon if you prefer a city night before the train, otherwise stay in Hongcun.

attractions.name: Xidi
attractions.description: Huizhou merchant village of memorial arches and carved halls.

attractions.name: Tunxi Old Street
attractions.description: Stone shopping street in Huangshan city, useful as a last-night base by the station.

days.title: Return to Hangzhou
days.notes: Huangshan North back to Hangzhou East. Qinghefang or a last West Lake walk. Buffer night before the flight.

attractions.name: Qinghefang
attractions.description: Old commercial street south of West Lake, close to the city hotels.

days.title: Departure
days.notes: Fly out of Hangzhou Xiaoshan (HGH). Afternoon departure leaves a slow morning.
